premises.text: Tourists desire authentic dining experiences and want to meet locals while traveling
premises.evidence_span: Most of the tourists want to meet the locals and to have an authentic dining experience.

premises.text: There is a basic human need to share food with others that exists across cultures and time
premises.evidence_span: we understood that this basic human need to share food with others existed in the past, it exists in the present, and it will continue to exist in the future.

premises.text: Eat With provides a community marketplace for authentic dining experiences
premises.evidence_span: Eat With is a community marketplace for authentic dining experiences.

premises.text: Hosts can earn income by sharing their cooking and dining experiences
premises.evidence_span: Eat With lets me do this, while earning some extra income.

premises.text: Eat With events are protected under a guarantee for customer safety
premises.evidence_span: all of his events are protected under the Eat With $1 million guarantee.

premises.text: The platform can disrupt the traditional restaurant industry

value.text: Consumers gain access to authentic dining experiences with locals
value.evidence_span: we want great food, interesting people, and unforgettable experiences.

notes: Pilot results showed significant local participation, indicating broader market potential.
